title: ID0424475-DC/Si-D/DE-[ MP / R6 170002000 ] charge not providing full power
description:
Reported issue: Today the Volvo on the D300 didn't want to charge at full power, even though it was the only car at the charging station
Solution: Install v7.0.5 and EcoG 1.4.12

additional_info.subject: ID0424475-DC/Si-D/DE-[ MP / R6 170002000 ] charge not providing full power CRM:02684000241
additional_info.body:
Hi Martin!
Seems like I get all your tickets :D but it's better this way since I know the full story behind Mauerstetten ;)
From my side, I clearly see the problem. The root cause I can only theorize since there is “no error”, that the problem was a converter not turning ON.
Since we already aligned on the fact that the IVECO is having issues from their side, can I please install the latest version? There is a fix for a problem with the converters that I am assuming it's the root cause here.
I can update to same version as D160 if you wish otherwise let me know if you prefer v6.1.3.
If you prefer to keep this version and you are having this issue, please call me immediately since I can connect to the charger remotely and confirm my suspicions. Otherwise it's very hard for me to provide a 100% correct answer.
Thanks a lot!
Best regards,
Francisco
